canonical_example.text: Sara y su novio cortaron porque Sara le puso los cuernos.
canonical_example.translation: Sara and her boyfriend broke up because Sara cheated on him.

canonical_example.text: Los papás de Harry cortaron cuando tenía dos años.
canonical_example.translation: Harry's parents split up when he was two years old.

canonical_example.text: Vamos a cortar por el estacionamiento del supermercado.
canonical_example.translation: Let's cut through the grocery store parking lot.

unused_menu_senses.context: to take a shortcut through; used with "por"

source_metadata.context: to take a shortcut through; used with "por"

canonical_example.text: ¿Por qué cortó tu hermano?
canonical_example.translation: Why did your brother hang up?

canonical_example.text: Me corté con un cuchillo mientras cortaba una manzana.
canonical_example.translation: I cut myself with a knife while I was cutting up an apple.

canonical_example.text: Los pandilleros se cortaron durante la pelea.
canonical_example.translation: The gang members cut each other during the fight.

canonical_example.text: Se me cortaron los labios por el frío.
canonical_example.translation: My lips got chapped because of the cold.

canonical_example.text: Se cortó la línea; ahorita la vuelvo a marcar.
canonical_example.translation: We got cut off; I'll call back in a minute.

canonical_example.text: La crema poblana se va a cortar si la calientas demasiado.
canonical_example.translation: The poblana chili pepper cream will curdle if you overheat it.

canonical_example.text: No te cortes ahora, hijo. Tienes que exigir tus derechos.
canonical_example.translation: Don't clam up now, son. You have to fight for your rights.

canonical_example.text: Aureliano se cortó al momento de pedir la mano de su novia.
canonical_example.translation: Aureliano lost his nerve as he was about to ask his girlfriend to marry him.
